basic_info.description: Since 1996, we have been passionately working on the development and intelligent linking of innovative logistics systems. Starting with our first patent for a pick-by-light solution, which we have been continuously developing for over 25 years now, we have established ourselves on the market with various products in the field of intralogistics. Our portfolio of mobile robots enables, for example, the customer-specific handling of complex transport and supply tasks both in shuttle operation and in production lines. We do not use a higher-level control center, but instead rely on agent-based control with swarm intelligence. This allows us to implement projects with just a few robots as well as with swarms of several hundred SAFELOG robots without incurring high costs for a control center or additional control software. Our solutions are used in production, distribution, and order picking in a wide range of industries, such as automotive, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering. As a software-based system provider, we can respond flexibly and quickly to customer-specific requests and implement them together with you.
